scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:ui" "npm run dev:desktop"
scripts.dev:desktop: wait-on http://localhost:4200 && UI_DEV_URL=http://localhost:4200 API_BASE=http://127.0.0.1:3030 npm -w apps/desktop run dev
scripts.api:serve: cross-env PORT=3030 npm -w apps/api run start
scripts.api:service-install: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const path = require('path'); const node = process.execPath; const script = path.resolve('apps/api/dist/server.js'); execSync(`nssm install TailoredApi \"${node}\" \"${script}\"`, {stdio:'inherit'}); execSync(`nssm set TailoredApi AppDirectory \"${path.resolve('apps/api')}\"`, {stdio:'inherit'}); execSync('nssm set TailoredApi Start SERVICE_AUTO_START', {stdio:'inherit'});"
scripts.build: npm -w apps/api run build && npm -w apps/ui run build && npm -w apps/desktop run build
scripts.start:desktop: npm run build && npm -w apps/desktop run start
scripts.package:desktop: npm -w apps/api run prisma:generate && npm run build && npm -w apps/desktop run package:linux
scripts.package:desktop:win: npm -w apps/api run prisma:generate && npm run build && npm -w apps/desktop run package:win
